title: Closed-immersion transport of a power-annihilated formal kernel
statement: Let j:Z -> X be a closed immersion of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], f:X -> S with j followed by f locally of finite type, and Q a quasi-coherent ideal. Choose any Abelian structure on Coh(X,Q) [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian]. Let M in Coh(X,Q) and G in Coh(Z,Q O_Z) [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] be identified by M ~= j_*G as inverse systems. Let H be a coherent module on Z with support proper over S [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Let L be a quasi-coherent ideal with nonempty complement of V(L). Given alpha:G -> H^wedge, a positive integer t and a limiting kernel fork k for alpha whose point is annihilated termwise by L^t, there exist N in Coh(X,Q), a:M -> N, and an ideal J strictly containing j.ker, such that J annihilates kernel a. Moreover some closed subscheme T -> X proper over S annihilates N.

source.place: Theorem 088E, paragraphs 2--4 (closed quotient, Chow modification, projective algebraization and proper push-pull comparison); verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088E

proof.text: Choose the closed formal equivalence E and its specified underlying-system comparison eta. Take D to be the completion of H and N to be the formal object underlying E(D). The component eta(D) identifies N with the termwise pushforward of D. The full-subcategory morphism a is explicitly e.hom followed by the pushforward of alpha followed by eta(D).inv; cancellation of the target isomorphism proves the commuting square.

Define J=(L^t).map j using the existing ideal-sheaf map. Monotonicity and map_bot give j.ker <= J. If equality held, support_map, closedness of j and support_pow would put j(z) in the image of Supp(L) for a point z in the nonempty complement. Injectivity of j then puts z in Supp(L), a contradiction. This is the proved helper ker_lt_map_power.

Apply closedImmersion_formalKernel_annihilated to a, alpha, the two system isomorphisms and the proved square. It gives AnnihilatedBy Q J (kernel a). This is the only new open subargument; it makes no proper-support or strict-containment claim.

The coherent/finite-type criterion supplies the instances needed by module_support_proper_over_base. Apply its proper-support characterization to obtain a closed immersion i:T->Z proper over S and a quasi-coherent finite-type F with H isomorphic to i_*F. T is Noetherian, so F is coherent. The formal completion comparison for i, the pushforward composition isomorphism, and the formal equivalence for i followed by j identify the already constructed N with a formal object supported on i followed by j. Apply the existing public formalModuleQuotient_factor at m=n=1 to each component of the system isomorphism. Its factorization through the target ideal-module product, which is zero, makes the source product inclusion followed by that isomorphism zero. Cancel the monomorphic isomorphism component and use IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero for the source product inclusion. No multiplication-naturality or zero-of-mono theorem is restated. Associate the composite to retain the supplied properness.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersionFormalComparisonTransport
    {X Z S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (j ≫ f)] (Q : X.IdealSheafData)
    [Abelian (CoherentFormalModule X Q)]
    (M : CoherentFormalModule X Q) (G : CoherentFormalModule Z (Q.comap j))
    (e : M.obj ≅ G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward j)
    (H : CoherentModules Z)
    (hH : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver (j ≫ f) H.obj)
    (L : Z.IdealSheafData) (hU : (L.support.compl : Set Z).Nonempty)
    (α : G ⟶ (completion Z (Q.comap j)).obj H)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (k : KernelFork α) (hk : IsLimit k)
    (hkill : ∀ n : ℕ, IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
      (Scheme.idealSheafPower L.toModulesι t).2 (k.pt.obj.obj (op n)))) :
    ∃ (N : CoherentFormalModule X Q) (a : M ⟶ N) (J : X.IdealSheafData),
      j.ker < J ∧ AnnihilatedBy Q J (kernel a) ∧
      ∃ (T : Scheme.{u}) (i : T ⟶ X) (_ : IsClosedImmersion i),
        IsProper (i ≫ f) ∧ AnnihilatedBy Q i.ker N
